what_happened: Dispatch's premise 'task 275 is still in RESEARCHING' is now false: 275 reached [COMPLETED] on 2026-11-04/05 (commits through 2e0a82a53, archived in commit aac4a8c6a). Recovered its archived plan/summary from git history: both explicitly deferred the cross-repo scope question to task 401 and made no amendment, so the escalation is still live and actionable despite 275's terminal status -- but any eventual amendment note can no longer land in 275's own record (deleted on archival); it must land in the durable artifact that now owns the ruling's substance (task-lock.md's Orchestration-Queue CLI section) instead.

Tasks 398/399's own descriptions claim (dated 2026-10-13) that the agent-system/extensions/lean/index-entries.json leg for the four f49576632 notes 'was NOT updated' and README.md line_count is stale (31 vs actual 32). Measured 2026-11-05: this is no longer true. A THIRD record-less channel (a) dispatch (commit 9a43026d2, 'orchestrate conclusion: channel (a) direct fixes', 2026-10-16) silently repaired index-entries.json, including README.md's line_count (now 32, matching) and the full measurement-harness-strictness.md entry. All five affected index-entries.json rows are now internally consistent with their files, verified independently. This is a third, same-repo instance of the identical blind spot (a record-less dispatch editing territory two [NOT STARTED] task records believe they still own), strengthening the thesis beyond the single cross-repo incident the dispatch names.

All four primary citations in the dispatch (commits f49576632 and 4311617a2, tasks 398 and 399, and the four issue-log entry ids iss_1791886589088_do8mDR/iss_1791914943297_AoBxvm/iss_1791928136829_T0iDVg/iss_1791921588196_IcZKne) verified byte-for-byte against live git history and current task descriptions in one pass -- no discrepancy found in the core counterexample itself, only in two premises about what remains outstanding (see the two stale-premise issues logged alongside this one).

The settled decision (.decisions.json, option A) names agent-system/extensions/core/context/patterns/task-lock.md's Orchestration-Queue CLI section as the site for an amendment note, but that path is outside this task's declared file_scope AND inside concurrent sibling 419's declared file_scope (verified live in specs/state.json this dispatch). Since option A UPHOLDS the ruling rather than amending it, no amendment note is owed by the dispatch's own terms ('if the owner amends the ruling ... the amendment belongs there'). Planned resolution: site the full adjudication in file-footprint-overlap.md (in declared scope, and the acceptance criterion's named home) and exclude task-lock.md entirely, rather than widening scope into a sibling's territory without a serializing edge.

Both phases' covering checks were resolved mechanically at plan-authoring time rather than guessed: sourcing scripts/lib/suite-selection-lib.sh and calling suite_selection_select returned test-orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh for the script target and the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel for the markdown target, so each Tier Justification names a check that was observed to resolve rather than one assumed to exist.
